title: Group Anagrams
summary: Cluster words that are rearrangements of each other.
statement:
Group the entries of `words` so that each group holds exactly the words that are anagrams of one another — same letters, any order.

Sort the words **within** each group alphabetically. The groups themselves may come back in any order; the grader compares them as a set.

### Constraints

- 1 ≤ words.length ≤ 10,000
- 0 ≤ words[i].length ≤ 100
- Lowercase English letters only

### Example

```
["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"]
```

gives `[["ate","eat","tea"], ["nat","tan"], ["bat"]]` in some order.

> **Pick a key that anagrams share**
>
> Two words are anagrams exactly when their sorted letters match, so the sorted string makes a natural dictionary key. Comparing every pair instead is O(n²) and will time out on the large hidden case.

visibleTests.explanation: Three groups; order between them does not matter.
The empty string is its own group.
